title: ideal-agent made, and the general know-how moved in

considered: Proving the guard live before narrowing devlab (orchestration asked for that order); it was proven by giving both guards the same 19 events first and live in a fresh session after.
rejected: A shell guard (fragile reading of shell lines); prebuilt binaries first (backlog release-binaries).
